name: Storage Redundancy (LRS/ZRS/GRS/GZRS)
plain_english: Azure Storage keeps multiple copies of your data to protect against failures. LRS 3 copies in 1 datacenter. ZRS 3 copies, one in each of 3 zones.
african_examples: LRS 3 copies on the same shelf in one M-Pesa shop.
ZRS 3 copies, one in each of 3 M-Pesa shops across town.
GRS copies in Nairobi AND a backup in Dar es Salaam. GZRS 3 shops in Nairobi 1 in Dar.
common_wrong_answer: GRS lets me read from the secondary region any time.
correction: Not by default you need RA-GRS for read access to the secondary before failover.
